corrections.reason: Visual inspection of Col 1 L08 shows 'እደ' (with the central loop of 6th-order 'እ' as in L09 'እየመራች', and 1st-order 'ደ' without the top-left hook of 'ድ'), forming the Patristic phrase 'እደ ብርሀት እየመራች' ('a hand of light guiding him').
The first character of L27 has the shortened left leg of 4th-order 'ባ', completing the Ge'ez verb 'ዘረባሐከ' ('that which profited you').
The printed text in Col 3 L31 clearly reads 'አዕሩግ እስራኤል' ('the elders/old men of Israel', plural of 'ዓሩግ'), where 'አዕ' was misread as 'እስ'.
